lines.text: Jesus says to keep lamps burning, like servants waiting for their master to return from a wedding banquet.
The master finds his servants on watch and dresses himself to serve, and he waits on them at the table.
Jesus says the Son of Man comes at an unexpected hour, and John asks if the parable is for everyone.
The faithful manager gives the servants their portion on time and is put in charge of all the master's possessions.
The master comes on a day the servant does not expect and assigns him a place with the hypocrites.
